CHOOSY — An app for people who struggle to make decisions

Overview

CHOOSY is a decision-making application designed to help people who struggle with everyday choices: what to eat, where to go, or what to do.

Problem

  • Choice overload: too many options make it difficult to choose.
  • Decision fatigue: making decisions throughout the day is mentally exhausting.
  • Lack of information: missing details such as time, budget, weather or dietary restrictions slow decisions.
  • Fear of making the wrong choice.
  • Group decision making: different preferences make it harder to agree.

UI design

An experimental app concept made for a university project, exploring how playful illustration and the phone's sensors can make everyday choices feel fun. Sensors as input; one answer at a time; always a next step.

01 What to do? Shake to decide

Shake the phone to roll a virtual dice; choosing becomes a game.

02 What to cook? Ingredient-based meals

Tap the ingredients you have; the meal is cooked on screen and served with a recipe card.

03 Where to go? Location-based activities

Your location is detected and CHOOSY reveals one specific spot with directions.

04 Barometer: weather-based suggestions

Swipe through drinks, food, music, films and activities that match the weather.

Illustration assets

Food illustrations drawn for the app.
